findings.description: The match path switched from re.match (prefix match) to fullmatch (whole-string match), which the commit title does not mention.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="Connection") and an exception whose str is "Connection refused". The old self.match.match returned a match and the retry happened. With fullmatch the pattern must cover the entire message, so it returns False and the retry is silently skipped. Callers relying on prefix or search-style patterns lose retries with no error, so the change alters existing behavior beyond the stated intent.
